title: Prescriptions Terms for Patients: Moving a Prescription or Transferring It Out
content:
A prescription held under Kestrel Prescriptions can move to another Kestrel store, which shares the same prescription system, or be transferred to a pharmacy outside Kestrel, on the terms below.

## Moves between Kestrel stores

A move between Kestrel stores changes only the holding store and is allowed where the class allows a store move; where the class allows a move only before the first fill, the move is allowed only while the prescription is in received status.

## Transfers out of Kestrel

A transfer to a pharmacy outside Kestrel is allowed only where the class allows a transfer out and the prescription is in received or active status, and, class by class:

- where the class requires no prior transfer, only when the prescription's prior transfer count is 0;
- where the class requires an unfilled prescription, only while the prescription is in received status;
- where the class requires an electronic origin, only when the prescription arrived as an electronic prescription.

## Conditions common to both

- A prescription with an open owed balance is not transferred out or moved until that balance is completed or cancelled. This is read from the owed quantity on the prescription record.
- A prescription with a fill still in will-call is not transferred out until that fill is picked up or returned to stock.

## What leaves with the prescription

On transfer out every remaining refill leaves with the prescription, and the destination pharmacy's name and phone number are recorded exactly as the patient states them.

## Applying the terms (hypothetical records)

| Request | Record facts | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Move to another Kestrel store | owed quantity above 0 | not moved until the balance is completed or cancelled |
| Transfer out | status active, a fill waiting in will-call | not transferred out until the fill is picked up or returned to stock |
| Transfer out, class requires no prior transfer | prior transfer count 1 | not allowed |
| Transfer out | status expired | not allowed; the status must be received or active |
